title: DGX Sparks
description: Host, GPU (dcgm-exporter) and ConnectX-7 (DOCA telemetry) metrics for the DGX Spark ring. Added 2026-11-23: every host series, every DCGM series, every device-level ConnectX counter, the collector's own scrape health, and a box that shows any series by name; the Spark selector picks the head, the worker or both on those tabs. Undo: runs/observe-review-20261123 in the recipe repository.

panels.description: dcgm_fi_dev_total_energy_consumption is in millijoules; its rate / 1000 is watts.

panels.title: About these panels
panels.markdownContent: DOCA telemetry holds 2,643 series a Spark. The 321 device-level counters are all on the panels below, grouped by what they describe (counters as per-second rates, gauges as stored; one line a host and port). The other 2,322 are the same counters split by receive or transmit queue (`rx0_*` … `rx19_*`, `tx0_*` … `tx19_*`, `ch0_*`) or by priority; show any of them on the *Any series* tab by typing its name.

panels.title: About this tab
panels.markdownContent: Type any metric name held for the Sparks into **Any series name** at the top (for example `rx0_packets`, `tx7_bytes`, `ch3_poll`, `system_cpu_time`, `dcgm_fi_dev_gpu_temp`). The full list of names is in `runs/observe-review-20261123/COVERAGE.md` and `data/` beside it.
